module.purpose: Implements React.Children helper APIs (map, forEach, count, only, toArray) for traversing and transforming React element children with stable key generation.
module.summary: This module provides the internal implementation of the React.Children object. It exposes functions to map, iterate, count, extract, and flatten React child collections, handling arrays, iterables, lazy elements, and thenables. It generates escaped key strings to maintain consistent identity across nested trees and validates element keys in development. The core recursion is performed by mapIntoArray, which walks children and invokes a callback to produce a flattened array of React nodes with composite keys.
module.businessContext: Part of React's public element manipulation API. If broken, child mapping in components fails, causing incorrect rendering or key warnings.
